Executive summary

Peaq Human Node (PHN) is designed to reward verified human-operated nodes. The protocol is peaq-first, with BNB Smart Chain support for token liquidity and future expansion to additional EVM chains only after the peaq user experience, sale flow and staking stack are stable.

Total supply100M PHN

Problem

DePIN networks need active machines and real operators, but early token systems often reward wallets before they prove useful participation. PHN approaches this by centering identity-gated node participation, peaq DID alignment and transparent on-site token flows.

Protocol model

Verified-human node activation

The node flow is designed around three gates: machine fingerprint, human attestation and peaq DID binding. The current website prepares wallet, DID and node command workflows; deeper automation must only go live after contract and infrastructure review.

Heartbeat rewards

Verified nodes are expected to send periodic heartbeats. Reward emission should be tied to valid operator identity and node activity, not passive wallet holding.

peaq-first rollout

The first production priority is peaq Mainnet support. BSC, Ethereum, BTC payment routing and additional chains are future phases and should not be marketed as live until deployed and verified.

Token and distribution

PHN has a fixed 100,000,000 token supply. The public distribution policy redirects 10,000,000 PHN from founder vesting into staking rewards. If allocation changes require treasury movements, those movements must be executed by the owner wallet and documented publicly.

Presale and burn routing
